answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because vault only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, walnut is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any oasis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
